summary: First MVP test run. Backend proxy (Brevo) and Expo/RN frontend (web preview) tested. 19/19 pytest backend tests PASS: root endpoint OK, missing X-Brevo-Key returns 401 with normalized detail.message, invalid key ('invalid-test') on GET/POST/PUT returns 401/4xx (never 500) with normalized detail.message, error normalization confirmed on all 8 route/method combos. Frontend UI: App boots to Campaigns tab with 'Connect your Brevo account' empty state; bottom-tab navigation Campaigns<->Contacts<->Settings works; 'Go to Settings' CTA navigates correctly; Settings screen renders hero banner, API key input, 'Not connected' status banner, and Save Key button; entering invalid key + Save Key keeps status as 'Not connected' (error toast triggered, verified via console 401 log and DOM). No React Native red-screen, no runtime pageerror; only benign react-native-web deprecation warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents, useNativeDriver). No deprecated Expo packages detected (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, or expo-background-fetch).

ui_bugs.issue: Test spec asked for 'Add Contact FAB present on Contacts empty state'. In code, FAB is only rendered when isConnected=true (contacts.tsx:201). While disconnected the not-connected StateView is shown without a way to create a contact. This is likely intentional UX (add requires a key), but flag to main agent to confirm whether spec expected FAB to always render.

issues: Status banner text runs together: 'Not connectedAdd your API key below to connect.' — bannerTitle and bannerSub sit next to each other with no line break in web render (See settings.tsx:83-94). Visually acceptable on device (nested Text views); on web preview a newline/space between them would read cleaner.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Decide if 'Add Contact FAB' should be visible in disconnected state (currently hidden by design; test spec suggested it should be present). If disconnected users should not create contacts, current behavior is correct — just clarify in spec.
OPTIONAL: Add a small margin/newline between banner title and banner sub in Settings status banner for cleaner web rendering.
No functional bugs — MVP is production-ready pending live test with a real Brevo API key.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py error normalization is solid: HTTPException(detail={message, raw}) uniformly across missing key (401), Brevo upstream 4xx passthrough, and 502 for network errors. No 500 leaks confirmed by 8-case parametrized test.
brevo.ts client correctly parses {detail: {message}} shape returned by FastAPI HTTPException, exposing readable error to UI (verified via invalid-key toast).
BrevoContext.saveKey validates the key by calling /account before persisting to secure storage — correct approach, prevents saving an invalid key.

All interactive elements have testID (verified: campaigns-not-connected, contacts-not-connected, add-contact-fab, api-key-input, save-key-button, settings-status-banner, toggle-key-visibility, disconnect-button, contacts-search-input, contact-row-*, campaign-card-*).
server.py POST/PUT read body via request.json() — accepts arbitrary payload and forwards to Brevo, matching product intent (no over-validation).
server.py imports Header/HTTPException/httpx — no unused imports beyond acceptable; file is 116 lines, well under threshold.
No hardcoded URLs in frontend — process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL used correctly in src/lib/brevo.ts.
seed_data_creation: None. No valid Brevo key available; live-data flows intentionally not tested.
context_for_next_testing_agent: When a real Brevo API key becomes available, run the frontend flow: enter real key in Settings -> Save -> status turns 'Connected' -> Campaigns tab populates KPIs (kpi-total-sent, kpi-campaigns, kpi-open-rate, kpi-click-rate) and campaigns list; Contacts tab populates list + search works; open a contact via contact-row-{id}; edit via contact/form; create via add-contact-fab. Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_brevo_proxy.py can be extended with a fixture reading BREVO_TEST_KEY env var to add positive-path tests.
test_credentials: N/A for this MVP — the only credential is a Brevo API key entered in-app by end user. No test key provided; used 'invalid-test' as agreed to validate error paths.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. All 19 backend tests + all 6 frontend UI checks passed on first run.
